title: India's SEZ Exports Rise 11.8% to ₹16.36 Lakh Crore (.28 Billion) in FY26
summary: Special Economic Zones remain India's primary engine for merchandise and services export growth.

blocks.content: Special Economic Zones remain India's primary engine for merchandise and services export growth.

items: Top Exporting State: Gujarat recorded highest SEZ exports worth ₹4,05,595 crore.
Followed By: Karnataka (₹2,69,004 crore), Maharashtra (₹2,43,422 crore), and Tamil Nadu (₹2,12,288 crore).
